scope: Independent read-only review of frozen-input preservation, common PG import normalization, count activity ingestion, SI/native power parsing, coordinate and solver completeness, spatial aggregation/statistics, outcome-independent run selection, conservative classification, final tables and draft response. No scientific artifact, source implementation or historical commit was edited by this reviewer.

test_evidence.description: Saved relevant Gate10A/Gate09/receipt tests and direct negative parser tests pass. Current bound test bytes match. Reviewed runner and measurement source exactly match shared-qualified snapshots; reporter bytes match final generation receipt.

resolved_findings.finding: Unconnected supply terminals on late inserted buffers prevented complete powered-cell processing.
resolved_findings.resolution: All nine inputs received only exact-name VDD/VSS PG assignments in memory. Before/after COMPONENTS, NETS, PINS, VIAS and PG shapes/vias remain identical; original routed ODBs are not written. Common repair and audit are disclosed.

resolved_findings.finding: Zero global activity overrode measured pin counts; provisional smoke4 had zero nonclock switching.
resolved_findings.resolution: Global override removed while explicit input defaults and complete net annotation remain. Provisional attempts4/5 preserved and excluded. Final common controls require positive nonclock response, linear density doubling, fixed clock and reproducible per-record outputs.

resolved_findings.finding: Initial runner only decoded native JSON without numeric SI integrity or complete geometry bounds checks.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final runner rejects incomplete/duplicate populations, negative/nonfinite values, out-of-die instance/terminal/segment/source coordinates and solver errors; native category/instance/log SI closure uses a population-derived binary32 bound. Direct negative tests cover key failures.

resolved_findings.finding: Preregistered secondary peak-cycle maps and explicit machine research question were initially missing.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final reporter reconstructs per-bin peaks from bound compact counts and checks their maxima against frozen H4/H8. Mean and peak statistics are separately identified. Exact external question, locations and diagnostic current overlaps are retained; no secondary/current statistic enters classification.

resolved_findings.finding: Early run selection could prefer legacy locally qualified but scientifically inadmissible attempts.
resolved_findings.resolution: Final selector uses earliest admissible nominal record with the shared-qualified runner/Tcl fingerprint and explicit invalidation bindings; all four controls and selected outputs are hash-verified.

resolved_findings.finding: Native Clock-partition reporter applied an excessively tight double-precision aggregate equality test to float32 native design sums.
resolved_findings.resolution: Known instance-population gamma_n bound now qualifies native comparisons and retains signed discrepancies/bounds. Original failed generation, all nine output hashes and reporter source are archived with exact preservation mappings. Regression accepts an in-bound discrepancy and rejects an out-of-bound discrepancy.

resolved_findings.finding: Earlier final test receipt no longer matched an updated reporter test source.
resolved_findings.resolution: Earlier test receipts preserved; uniquely named reviewed Linux validation passes 115 tests and all 17 current test source hashes match.

scientific_findings: All nine selected architecture records are QUALIFIED with no unresolved qualification errors.

All seven candidate/control comparisons independently reproduce the fixed materiality assessments. None meets both worst and p99 absolute/relative improvement thresholds; both B5 controls also have more than 2% scan-wire cost.

All eight co-primary/reference Pearson and average-tie-rank Spearman values independently agree with complete stored vectors to 1e-12. The b14 criterion passes but all four b15 rank records fail; complete cross-design correspondence is unmet.
The independently reconstructed classification is PACT_GATE10A_NO_MATERIAL_PHYSICAL_IMPACT with FREEZE recommendation, matching machine records.

Per-design source/PDN geometry hashes are common. Tracked published Gate09 paths and existing algorithm sources remain unchanged; all reported reexecuted search/ATPG/placement/routing/extraction/replay counts are zero.

Missing observations and mathematically undefined/constant vectors are unavailable rather than zero; primary occupied domains exclude unoccupied die bins. Both correlations and fixed IoU are retained without favorable-statistic selection.
limitations: The recommendation applies to this registered activity-derived static model and two related benchmark designs. It is not general proof that every possible physical implementation lacks benefit.
Fixed 0.5 duty and settled counts lack measured occupancy and physical glitches. Activity-to-power correspondence is partly model-coupled.
No transient droop, thermal hotspot, ground-bounce, package or signoff validation was performed. Segment current is not current density; qualified metal cross-section is unavailable.

Native voltage export is about 1 µV resolution; currents have roughly four significant digits. Interpolated percentile changes below that voltage resolution do not resolve internal solver differences.

Installed OpenROAD binary identity is hash-bound, but embedded source linkage was not independently rebuilt. Current upstream source only corroborates ABI behavior; direct runtime component casts and native SI closure supply additional evidence.

Figure source was reviewed for signed deltas and common scales, and figure output bindings are included. Visual figure QA and publication authorization are separate root-agent checks; this review does not authorize remote publication.
